install: sed -i '/case \$- in/,/esac/d' ~/.bashrc 2>/dev/null || true; grep -qxF 'export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH"' ~/.bashrc || echo 'export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH"' >> ~/.bashrc; export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH"; rustup toolchain install "$(sed -n 's/^channel = "\(.*\)"/\1/p' rust-toolchain.toml)" --profile minimal --component rustfmt,clippy; if [ "$(uname -s)-$(uname -m)" = "Linux-x86_64" ] && ! z3 --version 2>/dev/null | grep -q '5.4.1'; then mkdir -p "$HOME/.local/bin" /tmp/z3-dl && curl -fsSL -o /tmp/z3-dl/z3.zip "https://github.com/Z3Prover/z3/releases/download/z3-5.4.1/z3-5.4.1-x64-glibc-2.39.zip" && echo "b548bac48ef2452b4e09ea2945cf4b011d5f43fcf39e4799df268ee7e0769d85  /tmp/z3-dl/z3.zip" | sha256sum -c - && unzip -qo /tmp/z3-dl/z3.zip -d /tmp/z3-dl/extracted && cp "$(find /tmp/z3-dl/extracted -type f -name z3 | head -n 1)" "$HOME/.local/bin/z3" && chmod +x "$HOME/.local/bin/z3" && rm -rf /tmp/z3-dl; fi
